test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Black holes can has powerful effects on their surroundings.
solution:
The correct answer is "**has powerful effects.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is due to incorrect verb usage.
 
• The verb '**has**' is incorrect as it does not agree with the subject
